title: Reducing Safety Margin
statement: Reducing the safety margin will encourage the robot to take more direct paths to the goal, potentially reducing the number of collisions by allowing it to come closer to obstacles.
mechanism: The safety margin is a buffer zone that the robot maintains to avoid obstacles. Decreasing this margin can make the robot more aggressive in its path planning.
contradicting_evidence: Experiment plan_8c9b9b78: Observed delta=+1.000. Verdict: degraded (Collisions increased from 0.0 to 1.0 (+1.0).).
